purpose: S2 experiment: on the phone nights whose seed is established, does any constant press-phase error (deltaMs, the whole schedule shifted against the office clock) or uniform office-timer rate error (timerRate, the timer's share of the reconstructed clock), alone or combined, make the model's occupied mask windows agree with the phone's reads? A shared origin or timer-rate measurement error is upstream of both host programs and was never varied; the press rules moved presses by at most ~100 ms.
modelOptionsNote: the options the retained control result ran under (its method.modelOptionsSha256 b7eddb6025147181a8f837ed15e013925809c03d37d9f9b8aa358984daad44a4); the nights config's plain sourced-rebuild-model-options.json has changed since and would not reproduce the control

control.rule: at deltaMs 0 and timerRate 0 each night's model window string must equal the retained variant's windows.model byte for byte

grid.timerRateRule: timerRate r scales every office update's timer delta by (1 + r): r < 0 runs the office timer slower than the reconstructed clock, delaying rolls in image time; presses stay pinned to captured frames (the sched rule, no landing latency). A night with no frame trace cannot separate the two clocks and runs deltaMs only.

refine.rule: after the coarse grid, every traced night refines around its own best coarse cell: deltaMs within +-1000 ms at 100 ms, timerRate within +-0.02 at 0.005; a night with no trace refines deltaMs only. Cells already run are not repeated.

verdict.matchRule: a cell matches when unplayed = 0, compared >= matchMinCompared and agree = compared: every phone-read window the model played agrees
verdict.improveRule: a night improves when its best cell's agreeing windows (count) reach the control's plus ceil(improveMargin x the control's compared windows); a cell that dies early and agrees on a bare majority of the few windows it played does not improve anything
verdict.consistencyRule: matching cells across nights are consistent when every pair's deltaMs differs by at most consistentDeltaMs and every pair's timerRate by at most consistentRate
verdict.statusRule: ALIGNMENT_CELLS_FOUND if any night has a matching cell; IMPROVED_NOT_ALIGNED if none matches but some night improves; NO_PHASE_RATE_ALIGNMENT otherwise (no constant phase or uniform rate cell in this grid reproduces or approaches the phone's occupied windows on these nights)
